<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard Arch packaging practices. The source definitions fetch prebuilt Debian packages from the official GitHub releases of the Weasis project (nroduit/Weasis), which aligns with the project's upstream distribution. The URLs use HTTPS and target the correct version tag.

Running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` would only fetch the declared sources and source the PKGBUILD itself — no `prepare()`, `build()`, or `package()` functions execute during these commands. There is no top-level command substitution, no `pkgver()` function, and no network activity outside of the standard source fetching. The checksums are properly pinned with SHA-512 values, and no obfuscated or suspicious code exists in the global scope.

Extraction of the .deb archives during source fetching is the intended behavior for auditing these sources, and no code execution occurs as a result of these specific commands.
</details>
<summary>Packaging follows standard practices; safe for source inspection.</summary>
</security_assessment>

The package downloads prebuilt Debian packages (.deb) from the project's own GitHub releases repository (nroduit/Weasis), which is consistent with the declared upstream URL (https://nroduit.github.io/). This is expected upstream behavior for a -bin package.

The package includes properly pinned sha512 checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, providing integrity verification for the downloaded binaries. The checksums are not set to SKIP, which is good practice.

<details>
The PKGBUILD defines sources for x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, both pointing to prebuilt `.deb` packages hosted on GitHub Releases under the official `nroduit/Weasis` repository. These URLs are predictable and tied to the declared `pkgver`, with no use of command substitution or dynamic URL generation that could introduce remote code execution during sourcing.

There is no top-level code execution outside of standard variable assignments. The `pkgver()` function is not defined, so no custom logic runs during sourcing to alter version detection. Checksums are provided via `sha512sums_*` arrays using strong hashes, further supporting source integrity (though even if they were 'SKIP', that would not make this phase unsafe). No network operations, file modifications, or data exfiltration occur during the sourcing of this PKGBUILD.

The commands `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo` will safely fetch the `.deb` files and parse metadata without executing any build or prepare steps. All operations are confined to downloading and verification — no malicious behavior is present in the global scope or `pkgver()` that could compromise this stage.
</details>
